Running Python code interactively: # Check the poc.ttf structure
import struct

with open('/workspace/poc.ttf', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"File size: {len(data)}")
num_tables = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
print(f"num_tables: {num_tables}")

for i in range(num_tables):
    off = 12 + i * 16
    tag = data[off:off+4].decode('latin1')
    offset = struct.unpack('>I', data[off+8:off+12])[0]
    length = struct.unpack('>I', data[off+12:off+16])[0]
    print(f"  {tag}: offset={offset}, length={length}")
    if tag == 'MVAR':
        mvar = data[offset:offset+length]
        print(f"    MVAR data: {mvar.hex()}")
        print(f"    majorVersion={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[0:2])[0]}")
        print(f"    minorVersion={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[2:4])[0]}")
        print(f"    reserved={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[4:6])[0]}")
        print(f"    valueRecordSize={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[6:8])[0]}")
        print(f"    valueCount={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[8:10])[0]}")
        print(f"    storeOffset={struct.unpack('>H', mvar[10:12])[0]}")
        # Value record
        vr = mvar[12:20]
        print(f"    value record tag={vr[0:4].decode('latin1')}, outerIndex={struct.unpack('>H', vr[4:6])[0]}, innerIndex={struct.unpack('>H', vr[6:8])[0]}")
        # Item variation store at storeOffset
        store_off = struct.unpack('>H', mvar[10:12])[0]
        store = mvar[store_off:]
        print(f"    item store at offset {store_off}: {store.hex()}")
        print(f"    format={struct.unpack('>H', store[0:2])[0]}")
        print(f"    regionOffset={struct.unpack('>I', store[2:6])[0]}")
        print(f"    dataCount={struct.unpack('>H', store[6:8])[0]}")
        data_off = struct.unpack('>I', store[8:12])[0]
        print(f"    dataOffset[0]={data_off}")
        # Region list at regionOffset
        region_off = struct.unpack('>I', store[2:6])[0]
        region = store[region_off:]
        print(f"    axisCount={struct.unpack('>H', region[0:2])[0]}")
        print(f"    regionCount={struct.unpack('>H', region[2:4])[0]}")
        # Region record
        rr = region[4:10]
        print(f"    region: start={struct.unpack('>h', rr[0:2])[0]}, peak={struct.unpack('>h', rr[2:4])[0]}, end={struct.unpack('>h', rr[4:6])[0]}")
        # varData at dataOffset
        vd = store[data_off:]
        print(f"    varData: itemCount={struct.unpack('>H', vd[0:2])[0]}, shortDeltaCount={struct.unpack('>H', vd[2:4])[0]}, regionIdxCount={struct.unpack('>H', vd[4:6])[0]}")
        print(f"    regionIndices[0]={struct.unpack('>H', vd[6:8])[0]}")
        print(f"    deltaSet[0]={struct.unpack('>h', vd[8:10])[0]}")
